ba.title: What Bailo changes day to day
ba.subtitle: Three common situations in a residence in Cameroon.

b1.before: The caretaker writes in a notebook, hand-writes a receipt, forgets the cash box at home that evening.
b1.after: One tap, numbered receipt generated, auto-sync at the office — zero paper trail lost.

b2.before: You copy 30 lines into Excel to know who paid and how much is missing.
b2.after: Dashboard up to date in real time: collected, remaining, late tenants, split by payment mode.

b3.before: You spend a day preparing documents, extracting payments, computing site totals.
b3.after: OHADA export in one click: journal, ledger, entries ready to hand over.

faq.title: Answers to common questions
faq.subtitle: Can't find your answer? Reach out via the help button at the bottom right.

q1.a: Yes. The Discovery plan covers up to 5 rooms, with no time or payment limit. No card is required at sign-up.

q2.a: Partly. The app is installable (PWA) and caches your screens. Payments entered offline are queued and sent when the network returns.

q3.a: Yes. Data is hosted in Europe (Railway EU West), encrypted in transit (HTTPS) and at rest. Each account is strictly isolated — one landlord never sees another's data.

q4.a: Yes. You can export your OHADA accounting as CSV at any time. A full export (all tenants and payments) is also planned from the Administration tab.

q5.q: Who has access to my residence?
q5.a: You decide. As an owner, you invite your managers and caretakers, assign them specific sites, revoke access anytime. Every action is logged in the audit journal.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This page explains in plain language what data Bailo collects, why, how long we keep it, whom we share it with, and your rights. It applies to the Bailo web application and its mobile derivatives.

data.title: 1. Data we collect
data.body:
— Account and team: name, phone, email (optional), role, hashed password.
— Management activity: residences, rooms, tenants, payments, charges, receipts. This data belongs to you.
— Technical logs: IP, device type, pages visited. Used only for security and troubleshooting.
— Cookies: one technical session cookie, needed to keep you signed in. No advertising trackers.

purposes.title: 2. Why we use this data
purposes.body:
— Provide the service (open, use, back up your account).
— Secure access (sign-ins, token rotation, anomaly detection).
— Support you if you contact us.
— Meet legal obligations (accounting, lawful authority requests).

legal.title: 3. Legal bases
legal.body: Performance of the contract between us (service delivery), your consent (where an optional treatment is offered), and our legal obligations (OHADA accounting, judicial requests).

sharing.title: 4. Sharing with third parties
sharing.body: We never sell your data. It is entrusted only to providers strictly necessary to run the service: hosting (Railway, Europe), Google (Gmail), only to send the emails containing your verification codes, Mobile Money provider (MTN or Orange, only for payments you initiate). Each provider is bound by confidentiality and security commitments.

retention.title: 5. Retention
retention.body:
— Active account: as long as your account exists.
— After account deletion: accounting entries are kept 10 years as required by OHADA law. Other personal data is deleted within 30 days.
— Technical logs: 90 days maximum.

rights.title: 6. Your rights
rights.body: At any time you can access your data, correct it, export it, request deletion (within accounting obligations), limit processing, withdraw consent. To exercise these rights, write to us — we respond within 30 days.

security.title: 7. Security
security.body: Connections are HTTPS-encrypted. Passwords are hashed with argon2 (never stored in plain text). Session tokens are rotated regularly and revocable from the Administration tab. Every administrative action is recorded in an immutable audit log.

contact.title: 8. Contact us
contact.body: Any question about this policy can be sent to the Bailo publisher: NDONGO Louis Pharel, Yaoundé — Douala, Cameroon. Email: pharelndongo2005@gmail.com. We respond within 30 days.
